# Websites, apps, games, AI tools, and cloud software.

> Software development services from Logicleap Technologies: websites, web apps, mobile software, game development, AI automation, APIs, integrations, and cloud software.

- Canonical HTML: https://logicleaptechnologies.com/services.html
- Markdown: https://logicleaptechnologies.com/services.md

Services 

Logicleap provides custom software development for clients who need a reliable digital product, a public website, a working app, a game feature, or a practical automation workflow.

Websites 

### Website and web app development

Company websites, landing pages, support pages, policy pages, portals, forms, dashboards, and responsive web applications.

Apps 

### Product and mobile-ready software

Software for new product ideas, customer workflows, internal teams, app support surfaces, and client-facing experiences.

Games 

### Game development and technical support

Gameplay features, tools, integrations, live-service support, production debugging, release preparation, and technical reviews.

AI 

### AI workflow tools and automation

Practical AI-assisted tools for content workflows, operations, support, document processing, and repeated business tasks.

Cloud 

### Cloud software and integrations

APIs, backend services, third-party integrations, deployment support, automation, and maintainable infrastructure.

Clients 

## Who these services are for.

The work is useful for people who need a concrete software outcome, not a long consulting process.

Business owners 

### Need a professional website or client-facing tool

Get a public site, support pages, policy pages, inquiry flow, and lightweight software that explains the business clearly.

Founders 

### Need a product built from a clear starting point

Turn requirements, sketches, or a rough idea into a working product interface, prototype, or launch-ready system.

Studios 

### Need focused game or tooling help

Get extra engineering capacity for game systems, platform issues, tools, integrations, or production debugging.

Teams 

### Need automation for repeated work

Build internal tools that reduce manual steps across documents, support, data, content, and operations.

Delivery 

## How projects are handled.

Services are delivered digitally. There is no physical shipping or return process for software-service engagements.

Scope 

### Define the work

Clarify the problem, users, deliverables, assumptions, platform requirements, timeline, and expected output.

Build 

### Build with checkpoints

Implement the agreed work with reviewable progress, practical testing, and clear communication.

Launch 

### Deploy or hand over

Deliver the working site, app, tool, build, or repository with documentation and support details.

Support 

### Support the result

Handle agreed follow-up questions, fixes, improvements, and operational support after delivery.

Support

## Contact support

Email: [support@logicleaptechnologies.com](mailto:support@logicleaptechnologies.com)

For paid apps, in-app purchases, or service-related payment questions, we aim to respond within three business days. If Google Play or another platform contacts us about an urgent product issue, we aim to respond within 24 hours.

## Privacy and data requests

For access, correction, or deletion requests, use the instructions on the [Data Deletion](https://logicleaptechnologies.com/data-deletion.html) page or email [support@logicleaptechnologies.com](mailto:support@logicleaptechnologies.com).

Product 

Include the product, app, or project name.

Environment 

Include device, operating system, browser, or platform details.

Evidence 

Include steps to reproduce, screenshots, and any order or invoice reference.

Account 

Include the email address used for the product or purchase if relevant.

# Privacy Policy

> Privacy Policy for Logicleap Technologies websites, apps, support channels, and software products.

- Canonical HTML: https://logicleaptechnologies.com/privacy-policy.html
- Markdown: https://logicleaptechnologies.com/privacy-policy.md

Last updated: 2026-05-05

**Developer:** Logicleap Technologies Private Limited, Pune, Maharashtra, India.

**Privacy contact:** [support@logicleaptechnologies.com](mailto:support@logicleaptechnologies.com)

## Scope

This Privacy Policy applies to Logicleap Technologies websites, apps, support channels, and software products that link to this policy. If a specific app or product has additional data practices, that app or product may provide additional notices in its store listing, in-app disclosures, or product documentation.

## Information we collect

| Category                | Examples                                                                                             | Purpose                                                                                        |
| ----------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| Contact information     | Name, email address, company name, support message content.                                          | Responding to inquiries, support requests, project discussions, and legal or privacy requests. |
| Project information     | Files, links, technical notes, repository or product details provided by a client.                   | Providing software development services and support.                                           |
| Technical information   | Browser, device, IP-derived region, server logs, crash diagnostics, or app version where applicable. | Security, debugging, service reliability, analytics, and abuse prevention.                     |
| Transaction information | Invoice references, payment status, billing contact details, and payment processor metadata.         | Processing payments, accounting, support, fraud prevention, and legal compliance.              |

## How we use information

- To provide, operate, maintain, and improve our websites, apps, software, and services.
- To respond to business, support, security, legal, and privacy inquiries.
- To perform contracts, issue invoices, process payments, and maintain business records.
- To detect, prevent, and investigate fraud, abuse, security incidents, and technical issues.
- To comply with applicable legal, tax, accounting, and platform requirements.

## Sharing

We do not sell personal information. We may share information with service providers that help us host websites, process email, provide cloud infrastructure, process payments, maintain records, or deliver support. We may also disclose information if required by law, to protect rights and security, or as part of a business transfer with appropriate notice.

## Security

We use reasonable technical and organizational safeguards for personal information. Personal and sensitive data should be transmitted using HTTPS or other modern cryptography where applicable. No internet or email system can be guaranteed to be completely secure.

## Retention

We keep personal information only as long as needed for the purposes described in this policy, including support, service delivery, legal, tax, accounting, security, and dispute-resolution requirements. Support requests are typically retained for up to 24 months unless a longer period is required. Business, accounting, and contract records may be retained for longer where required by law.

## Your choices and deletion requests

You may request access, correction, or deletion of personal information by emailing [support@logicleaptechnologies.com](mailto:support@logicleaptechnologies.com). If a Logicleap app allows account creation, the account and associated app data can be requested for deletion using the instructions on the [Data Deletion](https://logicleaptechnologies.com/data-deletion.html) page. We may need to verify your request and may retain certain records where required for security, fraud prevention, legal, tax, or accounting reasons.

## Children

Our website and business services are not directed to children. If a specific app is intended for children or families, it will provide additional disclosures and comply with applicable platform and privacy requirements.

## Changes

We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. The updated version will be posted on this page with a new “Last updated” date.

# Request account or data deletion.

> Request deletion of app account data or personal information handled by Logicleap Technologies.

- Canonical HTML: https://logicleaptechnologies.com/data-deletion.html
- Markdown: https://logicleaptechnologies.com/data-deletion.md

Use this page to request deletion of personal information or app account data associated with a Logicleap product.

## How to request deletion

1. Email [support@logicleaptechnologies.com](mailto:support@logicleaptechnologies.com) with the subject line “Data deletion request”.
2. Include the app, product, or service name.
3. Include the email address or account identifier used with the app or service.
4. State whether you want account deletion, support-message deletion, or another specific data deletion request.

## Verification

We may ask for information needed to verify that you are authorized to make the request. This helps protect accounts and personal information from unauthorized deletion.

## Deletion timing

After verification, we aim to complete eligible deletion requests within 30 days. If more time is needed, we will explain the reason where required by applicable law.

## Data that may be retained

Some information may be retained where required for security, fraud prevention, legal compliance, tax, accounting, dispute resolution, or legitimate business records. If retained, it will be limited to the purpose that requires retention.

## Apps without accounts

If a Logicleap app does not allow user account creation, account deletion may not apply. You can still contact support for questions about data associated with that app.

# Refund and Cancellation Policy

> Refund, cancellation, delivery, and payment policy for Logicleap Technologies software services and digital products.

- Canonical HTML: https://logicleaptechnologies.com/refund-policy.html
- Markdown: https://logicleaptechnologies.com/refund-policy.md

Last updated: 2026-05-05

## Software services

Logicleap provides custom software development and support services. Fees, deliverables, payment schedule, currency, and cancellation terms are defined in the written proposal, statement of work, agreement, or invoice for each engagement.

## Delivery

Services are delivered electronically through agreed communication channels, repositories, documents, builds, or deployment environments. Logicleap does not ship physical goods, so physical shipping and returns do not apply to software-service engagements.

## Payments and currency

Prices are project-specific and are stated in the relevant proposal or invoice. The invoice will specify the applicable currency before payment is requested.

## Cancellations

A client may request cancellation by emailing [contact@logicleaptechnologies.com](mailto:contact@logicleaptechnologies.com). Cancellation terms depend on the agreement for the engagement. Work already completed, committed project time, third-party costs, and non-cancellable expenses may remain payable.

## Refunds

Refunds for custom software services are reviewed case by case. Approved refunds generally apply only to unperformed work or duplicate/erroneous payments, unless the written agreement states otherwise.

## Apps and digital products

If a Logicleap app or digital product is purchased through Google Play, the App Store, Stripe, or another platform, refunds may also be subject to that platform’s rules and payment flow. Contact [support@logicleaptechnologies.com](mailto:support@logicleaptechnologies.com) with the order reference if you need help.

## Promotions

Logicleap does not currently publish general promotions, trials, or discount programs on this website. If a promotion is offered, its terms will be stated where the promotion is presented.

## Disputes

For billing questions or disputes, contact [contact@logicleaptechnologies.com](mailto:contact@logicleaptechnologies.com) before initiating a chargeback so we can review the issue promptly.

# Security and payment handling.

> Security and payment handling information for Logicleap Technologies websites, apps, and services.

- Canonical HTML: https://logicleaptechnologies.com/security.html
- Markdown: https://logicleaptechnologies.com/security.md

Logicleap uses practical safeguards to protect websites, software services, support communications, and payment workflows.

## Website security

This website is intended to be served over HTTPS. Do not submit sensitive information over an insecure connection.

## Payment information

If online card payments are enabled for a Logicleap product or invoice, card details are handled by the payment processor. Logicleap does not store full card numbers on this website.

## Service data

Client project files, source code, and access credentials should be shared through agreed secure channels. Avoid sending secrets or passwords by plain email unless specifically instructed to use an approved secure method.

## Report a security issue

Report security concerns to [support@logicleaptechnologies.com](mailto:support@logicleaptechnologies.com). Please include a clear description, affected URL or product, reproduction steps, and your contact details.
